title: Stop leaking internal error strings from scene activation

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0078 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-25 directive 'dale al merge y a lo que sigue' — the last of the thirteen hardening-audit findings, clearing the audit backlog. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0078.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors and the 2026-08-25 user directive.

claims.statement: The hardening audit found the POST /api/scenes/activate handler returned the raw internal error to the client as details: String(error) in its 500 body, exposing an internal failure string (e.g. a database path in an Error message) to any caller. The two sibling 500 handlers in the same router — POST /api/scenes and POST /api/scenes/:sceneId/activate — already returned a message-only body, so this handler was the lone outlier; a grep for 'details: String(error)' across server/src matched only this one site.
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/scenes.ts prior /scenes/activate catch block versus the /scenes and /scenes/:sceneId/activate catch blocks; the 2026-08-25 hardening-audit finding hardening-scene-activate-error-leak.

claims.statement: The change drops the details field from the 500 body so the handler returns only { code: INTERNAL_ERROR, message: 'Failed to activate scene' }, matching its two siblings. The raw error is unchanged in the server log (logger.error 'Error activating scene via API', { error: String(error) }), so operators keep the diagnostic while the client no longer receives it.
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/scenes.ts /scenes/activate catch block: the retained logger.error and the message-only res.status(500) body.

claims.statement: Forcing the activation service to throw and asserting the 500 response body carries no details field and no raw error text — while the failure is still named to the client as INTERNAL_ERROR — closes the information-leak finding.
claims.evidence: server/tests/unit/sceneActivateErrorLeak.test.ts is the falsification mechanism: it mocks activateSceneOnChannel to throw a recognizable secret string and asserts it never reaches the body.

claims.statement: The change is server-only and additive to a single catch block. No protocol or Studio change, and the success path, the 400 validation paths, and the two sibling handlers are untouched. The audit backlog is now cleared: this was the thirteenth and final confirmed finding; the only remaining hardening frontier node is the deferred durable-idempotency residual hardening-production-idempotency-persisted.
claims.evidence: git diff of the CHG-0078 branch: server/src/routes/scenes.ts and server/tests/unit/sceneActivateErrorLeak.test.ts; the frontier board after CHG-0077 (41 of 43 fulfilled).

successCriteria.statement: A 500 from POST /api/scenes/activate names the failure without leaking the internal error string.
successCriteria.verification: A test that makes the activation service throw asserts the 500 body has code INTERNAL_ERROR and message but no details field and no raw error text.

successCriteria.statement: The internal error is still available to operators.
successCriteria.verification: The handler still calls logger.error with the stringified error before responding.
The full server suite passes and the server type-check passes.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0078 records the leak, the lone-outlier scope, and the log-only retention before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: The /scenes/activate 500 body is message-only, matching its two siblings, with the error kept in the server log.
A test proves the internal error string never reaches the client body; the full server suite passes.
Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, focused and full tests, build, dependency audit and diff checks pass before handoff.
